title: GET /api/organizations/me returns 200 with the caller's org document
preconditions: Valid JWT for any active org member
expectedResult: 200 with { success: true, data: { name, domain, settings, subscription, usage, ... } } for the caller's own organization.

title: /organization loads the Overview tab without error for a user holding organization.read
steps: Log in as an org member with organization.read
expectedResult: OrganizationOverviewTab renders: stats cards (Total Users, Active Users, Administrators, Member Since) and the Organization Details card, with no error boundary or console error.

title: /organization/team loads and lists existing org users
expectedResult: UserAccessPage renders the user list populated from GET /api/users, with Invite/Add User actions visible to a permitted caller.

title: /organization/roles renders either the RolesTab grid (enterprise tier) or the TierGate locked state (lower tier) without erroring
steps: Navigate to /organization/roles as an org admin
expectedResult: Page renders one of the two valid states — the System/Custom role card grid, or TierGate's upgrade prompt — with no blank page, no unhandled exception, and no infinite loading skeleton.

title: /organization/settings loads current regional and notification preferences
expectedResult: SettingsTab renders Regional Settings, Notification Preferences, and Display Settings sections with values loaded from the org (not stuck on the loading skeleton).

title: A valid single-invite submission returns 201 and creates an invited user
preconditions: Org has at least 1 free seat
steps: POST /api/users with a well-formed { email, firstName, lastName, roleId }
expectedResult: 201 with { success: true, data: { status: 'invited', ... } } and message confirming the invitation email was sent.
